description: The GNOME desktop on Wayland, logged in as the box user at start, for Fedora images: the image and its boxes get a screen, shown with box view (GNOME needs polkit, and the polkit parameter says how it answers)

polkit.description: how polkit, which GNOME needs, answers a program that asks for a privileged action: deny refuses every request; debian follows the system's own rules (Fedora's here; the name is the one linux-gnome uses), so the box user and every program it runs, an agent included, can power the box off and mount disks and disk images without a password. Recipes/README.md says more

steps.name: A polkit choice this recipe knows
steps.run: case "$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT" in deny|debian) echo "polkit=$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT";; *) echo "the polkit parameter is deny or debian, not '$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT'" >&2; exit 1;; esac

steps.name: GNOME Shell and its Wayland session, the Ptyxis terminal and the Files manager, the GDM login manager and the accessibility bus, without weak dependencies, and xclip for the box window's clipboard buttons (through GNOME's X server, Xwayland)
steps.run: dnf -y install --setopt=install_weak_deps=False gnome-shell gnome-session-wayland-session gdm ptyxis nautilus xdg-user-dirs at-spi2-core xclip dconf polkit

steps.name: polkit's rules, as the polkit parameter says
steps.run: rules=/etc/polkit-1/rules.d/00-agent-vm.rules; case "$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT" in deny) printf '%s\n' '// agent-vm polkit=deny' 'polkit.addRule(function (action, subject) { return action.id == "org.freedesktop.login1.chvt" ? polkit.Result.YES : polkit.Result.NO; });' > "$rules.new";; debian) printf '%s\n' '// agent-vm polkit=debian' > "$rules.new";; *) echo "the polkit parameter is deny or debian, not '$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT'" >&2; exit 1;; esac && chmod 644 "$rules.new" && mv -f "$rules.new" "$rules" && restorecon "$rules"

steps.name: The box user logged in to GNOME at start, with no password (Fedora's GDM reads /etc/gdm/custom.conf)
The screen never locks, blanks or sleeps
The desktop starts with the system
steps.run: systemctl enable gdm.service && systemctl set-default graphical.target

update.name: polkit's rules, as the polkit parameter now says
update.run: rules=/etc/polkit-1/rules.d/00-agent-vm.rules; case "$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT" in deny) printf '%s\n' '// agent-vm polkit=deny' 'polkit.addRule(function (action, subject) { return action.id == "org.freedesktop.login1.chvt" ? polkit.Result.YES : polkit.Result.NO; });' > "$rules.new";; debian) printf '%s\n' '// agent-vm polkit=debian' > "$rules.new";; *) echo "the polkit parameter is deny or debian, not '$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT'" >&2; exit 1;; esac && chmod 644 "$rules.new" && mv -f "$rules.new" "$rules" && restorecon "$rules"

checks: [ "$(systemctl show -P Id display-manager.service)" = gdm.service ] && echo 'GDM starts with the system'
[ "$(systemctl get-default)" = graphical.target ] && echo 'the system starts to graphical.target'
grep -qx "AutomaticLogin=$(id -un)" /etc/gdm/custom.conf && echo "$(id -un) is logged in at start"

[ "$(gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.screensaver lock-enabled) $(gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.lockdown disable-lock-screen) $(gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.session idle-delay)" = 'false true uint32 0' ] && echo 'the screen never locks or blanks'

pkcheck --action-id org.freedesktop.login1.power-off --process $$ > /dev/null 2>&1; answer=$?; case "$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT:$answer" in deny:1) echo 'polkit refuses every request (polkit=deny)';; debian:2) echo "polkit follows the system's own rules (polkit=debian): what they allow the desktop's user, every program of $(id -un) can do";; *) echo "polkit=$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT, and polkit answered $answer to a request to power off"; exit 1;; esac
command -v xclip > /dev/null && echo 'the box window can copy text to and from the clipboard (xclip)'
